on_record.summary: The Fondation Famille Pierre Lassonde is listed among the museum's leading supporters (2025 annual report).
The Pierre Lassonde Pavilion by OMA, opened in June 2016, carries his name. He is among the donors of C$10 million and above, and paid his pledge ahead of time in 2023 to 2024.
The GraceKennedy Foundation co-sponsored a mural, Charl Baker’s Nature of Man, with ICD Holdings (2021).
A sponsor of the gallery’s 2022 biennial.
The Sabancı Foundation sponsors the Müzede Sahne and Müzede Suare programmes.
Staff of Sabancı Group companies, with one guest, pay the discounted ticket price.
Sabancı Holding, Akbank and the Sabancı Foundation are its listed supporters.
The family gave the mansion, its collections and furnishings to Sabancı University in 1998 to become the museum, which carries Sakıp Sabancı’s name.
Announced in October 2021 as sponsor of the Energy Revolution gallery, named Energy Revolution: The Adani Green Energy Gallery.
The National Education Union backed a schools boycott of the museum over its Adani and BP deals in June 2025; four London schools signed up on the first day.
When the BP deal ended in August 2026, Culture Unstained called it only a partial victory because the Adani sponsorship continues.
Ramiro Ortiz Mayorga and Patricia Gurdián de Ortiz founded the foundation in 1996, and from 1999 the family bought and restored the León houses that hold the collections.
Through the foundation, Banpro sponsors the Mariana Sansón National Prize for Poetry Written by Women, awarded each year since 2005.
Banpro sponsored the Managua centre, which opened on 11 December 2013 as the Centro de Arte Fundación Ortiz-Gurdián/Banpro.
Its corporate foundation, Fondation Al Mada (formerly Fondation ONA), runs the villa, which it converted into a cultural centre.
Partner, with the Collectif 4.0, of the Couleurs du Maroc family workshops on the esplanade, held on the last Saturday of each month from January 2026.
Founded it; opened in 2017 in the same park as his Onehome Art Hotel.
Shares works with his hotel in the same park: “What the museum shows, the hotel collects,” its director says, and the hotel's rooms store the collection.
